summary.oneLiner: Mach Travel Solutions is a diversified travel company with a strong presence in MICE, corporate travel, and leisure travel, poised for growth with its integrated travel solutions platform and expanding B2C segment.

hero.oneLiner: Mach Travel Solutions is a diversified travel company with a strong presence in MICE, corporate travel, and leisure travel, poised for growth with its integrated travel solutions platform and expanding B2C segment.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Incorporated in 2004 as a MICE company, evolved into an integrated travel and mobility platform serving enterprise, institutional, government and retail travel requirements.
- PAN India presence with 400+ employees, 20+ years of experience and event management across 25+ countries; affiliated with IATA, IATO, PATA and ADTOI.
- Cites strong, established industry relationships with airlines and hotels as a strategic advantage enabling smoother deals and better negotiation terms, plus a long-standing corporate customer base supporting B2C cross-sell via brand recognition.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: MICE: 273 programs (FY26); Corporate Travel: growing enterprise travel management platform; Leisure Travel: expanding B2C segment with launch of MachTravel.com

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: ₹142+ Cr order pipeline, with multiple large domestic and international mandates

guidance.title: Guidance / outlook
guidance.body: Targeting record revenues in FY27, with a focus on expanding B2C segment, widening footprint across India, and strengthening corporate, government, and institutional relationships.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Expansion into new markets, growing demand for travel and tourism, and increasing adoption of digital technologies

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: EBITDA margin: 9.7% (FY26); PAT margin: 6.5% (FY26); Employee benefit expenses: ₹792 lakhs (H2 FY26); Other administrative expenses: ₹11,568 lakhs (H2 FY26)

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Focus on strengthening balance sheet, reducing debt, and investing in growth initiatives

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Dependence on economic conditions, competition, and regulatory changes

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: Growing demand for sustainable tourism and digital transformation in the travel industry

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Rebranding] Company renamed from Mach Conferences and Events Limited to Mach Travel Solutions Limited in 2026, reflecting the pivot from MICE to an integrated travel platform.
- [Disruption] FY26 EBITDA and PAT margins improved despite temporary disruptions from Operation Sindoor and Middle East geopolitical developments, per the Chairman & Managing Director's letter.
- [Investor Relations] Adfactors Investor Relations (Vaibhav Gupta, Yash Sanghavi) acts as IR advisor alongside Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Yashashvi Srivastava.
